messages:
sasha: Preflight for 09:00 PT canary deploy (model-server v3.4.1). Change window 09:00-10:30 PT. @mike @hana please confirm backout/runbook links and who will execute rollback if needed. CI starts 08:55.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot scheduled rollout: prod-canary -> 10%/30%/60%/100% with 5m checks between stages. Preflight hook run at 08:58. See rollout ID: rollout-1763609876.

mike: Link to escape-hatch runbook: https://intranet.redwood/runbooks/escape-hatch — see section "Quick rollback" for kubectl commands and traffic cutover. I validated steps vs current manifests.

hana: Backout checklist (short):
1) Cut canary traffic: `redwood route update model-service --set-canary=0`
2) Roll deployment to pinned image: `kubectl set image deploy/model-server model-server=redwood/model-server:v3.3.9 -n prod`
3) Clear KV cache: `redis-cli -h cache.prod.redwood flushall`
4) Re-enable feature-flag fallback: `ff toggle model_v3 --state off`
5) Notify PD & open rollback ticket.
I also confirmed the v3.3.9 image passes smoke. I'm available to run step 2 if needed.

leah: Note: DB migrations are no-op for this release. Abort conditions per runbook: error-rate > 2% for 3 consecutive 1m windows OR p50 latency > 500ms sustained for 2m. If hit, abort and backout immediately.

sasha: Who executes the rollback? @mike are you oncall and able to run ops commands?

mike: I am oncall, have kube/sudo. I'll be standing by in voice channel. If I trigger rollback I'll: 1) post in this thread, 2) run kubectl set image, 3) cut canary route, 4) create JIRA ROLLBACK ticket and link PD incident.

ci-bot: ci-bot: preflight CI passed (smoke, basic-e2e). Post-deploy monitor hooks configured: perf-alerts -> PagerDuty (oncall_mike).

deploy-bot: deploy-bot attached runbook snapshot: https://intranet.redwood/runbooks/escape-hatch/snapshots/1763609800 (includes exact commands and metric thresholds).

sasha: Great. Quick reminders: pin any dependent services (cache/proxy) to known-good config for 09:00 window; no migrations; no schema changes. If someone sees anything to add to the runbook, edit now.

hana: Added one more step to runbook: verify KV TTLs after rollback: `redis-cli -h cache.prod.redwood --eval check_ttls.lua`. Also added note to rotate traffic via TrafficRouter first, then do kube rollback.

leah: I'll watch tracing / slow queries and post anomalies. If I see >3 slow spans/min I'll ping here and escalate. :mag:

mike: Understood. If I trigger rollback I'll post command output and close the rollout in deploy dashboard.

sasha: :thumbsup: Launching at 09:00. If anyone needs to abort early type `!abort-deploy` in this thread and @mike will act. Keep notifications on for the next 90m.

mike: :white_check_mark: standing by.
